WITH ev AS (
  SELECT t.trdref AS tradereg
  FROM transactionrecord t
  LEFT JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.transref = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.trdref
  HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN s.corpeventprx IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) > 0.3
), vs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tr.tradereg AS tradereg
  FROM trader tr
  JOIN ev ON ev.tradereg = tr.tradereg
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.risklevel') = 'Aggressive'
    AND ABS(s.newsscore - s.socscore) > 1.0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.modfreq / (1 - t.cancelpct)), 4) AS avg_omi
FROM transactionrecord t
JOIN vs ON vs.tradereg = t.trdref

SELECT e.penimp, COUNT(*) AS frequency
FROM enforcementactions e
JOIN investigationdetails i ON i.invdetreg = e.invdetref
JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.sentreg = i.sentref
WHERE s.infoleaksc > 50.0
  AND s.corpeventprx IS NOT NULL
  AND s.eventannotm IN ('Pre-market', 'Intraday')
  AND (0.6 * i.behansc + 0.4 * i.netansc) > 70
GROUP BY e.penimp
ORDER BY frequency DESC

WITH q AS (
  SELECT MIN(json_extract(risk_indicators, '$.qstuffindex')) AS qmin,
         MAX(json_extract(risk_indicators, '$.qstuffindex')) AS qmax
  FROM transactionrecord
), x AS (
  SELECT json_extract(t.risk_indicators, '$.layerind') AS layering_status,
         ( 0.2 * (json_extract(t.risk_indicators, '$.spoofprob') / 100.0)
         + 0.2 * (json_extract(t.risk_indicators, '$.frontscore') / 100.0)
         + 0.2 * ((json_extract(t.risk_indicators, '$.qstuffindex') - q.qmin) / (q.qmax - q.qmin))
         + 0.2 * (CASE json_extract(t.risk_indicators, '$.washsus')
                    WHEN 'Low' THEN 0.1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'High' THEN 1.0 END)
         + 0.2 * (CASE json_extract(t.risk_indicators, '$.layerind')
                    WHEN 'None' THEN 0.0 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 1.0 END)
         ) AS sai,
         (tr.voldaily / tr.acctbal)
           * json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio')
           * (t.modfreq / (1 - t.cancelpct)) AS ati
  FROM transactionrecord t
  JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref
  CROSS JOIN q
)
SELECT layering_status, ROUND(AVG(sai * ati), 3) AS avg_ass
FROM x
WHERE layering_status IN ('Confirmed', 'Suspected')
GROUP BY layering_status

SELECT e.enforcereg, e.traderestr
FROM enforcementactions e
JOIN compliancecase c ON c.compreg = e.compref2
JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = c.transref
JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref
WHERE (e.penimp IN ('Fine', 'Ban') OR e.acttake = 'Suspension' OR e.busrestr = 'Full')
  AND e.penamt / tr.acctbal > 0.1
  AND tr.freqscope = 'High'
  AND ((json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio') > 5.0
        AND json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.risklevel') = 'Aggressive')
       OR tr.voldaily / tr.acctbal > 0.5)

SELECT tr.tradekind,
       ROUND(AVG((tr.voldaily / tr.acctbal)
                 * json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio')
                 * (t.modfreq / (1 - t.cancelpct))), 2) AS avg_ati,
       ROUND(AVG(1.0 / (1 + (c.prevviol / MAX(1.0, tr.acctdays / 365.0))
                            * (CASE c.comprate WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2
                                               WHEN 'C' THEN 3 WHEN 'D' THEN 4 END))), 2) AS avg_chs
FROM trader tr
JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
JOIN compliancecase c ON c.transref = t.transreg
GROUP BY tr.tradekind
ORDER BY AVG((tr.voldaily / tr.acctbal)
             * json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio')
             * (t.modfreq / (1 - t.cancelpct))) DESC

WITH cand AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tr.tradereg AS tradereg
  FROM trader tr
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
  WHERE ((json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio') > 5.0
          AND json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.risklevel') = 'Aggressive')
         OR tr.voldaily / tr.acctbal > 0.5)
    AND (json_extract(t.risk_indicators, '$.layerind') = 'Confirmed'
         OR (json_extract(t.risk_indicators, '$.spoofprob') > 0.75
             AND t.modfreq / (1 - t.cancelpct) > 1.0))
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(ABS(a.patsim - a.peercorr) / MAX(0.01, a.patsim)), 2) AS avg_updr
FROM transactionrecord t
JOIN cand ON cand.tradereg = t.trdref
JOIN advancedbehavior a ON a.translink = t.transreg

SELECT t.transreg, t.trdref, t.transtime, s.infoleaksc,
       ROUND(s.optvolrt * (1 + ABS(s.newsscore - s.socscore)) * s.infoleaksc, 2) AS sdlr
FROM transactionrecord t
JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.transref = t.transreg
WHERE s.infoleaksc > 50.0
  AND s.corpeventprx IS NOT NULL
  AND s.eventannotm IN ('Pre-market', 'Intraday')
  AND s.optvolrt * (1 + ABS(s.newsscore - s.socscore)) * s.infoleaksc > 1000

WITH nmr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.trdref AS tradereg
  FROM transactionrecord t
  JOIN advancedbehavior a ON a.translink = t.transreg
  JOIN compliancecase c ON c.transref = t.transreg
  JOIN investigationdetails i ON i.compref = c.compreg
  WHERE ABS(a.patsim - a.peercorr) < 0.1
    AND a.peercorr > 0.7
    AND i.tcirclesz > 5 AND i.grpbehsc > 0.6 AND i.commpat = 'Regular'
)
SELECT c.compreg, ROUND(0.6 * i.behansc + 0.4 * i.netansc, 2) AS iii
FROM compliancecase c
JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = c.transref
JOIN nmr ON nmr.tradereg = t.trdref
JOIN investigationdetails i ON i.compref = c.compreg
ORDER BY iii DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT tr.tradereg
FROM trader tr
JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
JOIN compliancecase c ON c.transref = t.transreg
JOIN enforcementactions e ON e.compref2 = c.compreg
WHERE ((json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio') > 5.0
        AND json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.risklevel') = 'Aggressive')
       OR tr.voldaily / tr.acctbal > 0.5)
  AND (e.penimp IN ('Fine', 'Ban') OR e.acttake = 'Suspension' OR e.busrestr = 'Full')
  AND c.lastrevdt >= date((SELECT MAX(lastrevdt) FROM compliancecase), '-12 months')

WITH pms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.trdref AS tradereg
  FROM transactionrecord t
  JOIN advancedbehavior a ON a.translink = t.transreg
  WHERE ABS(a.patsim - a.peercorr) < 0.1 AND a.peercorr > 0.7
)
SELECT CASE WHEN tr.tradereg IN (SELECT tradereg FROM pms) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_peer_mimicry_suspicion,
       ROUND(AVG(json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.winpct')
                 / MAX(1.0, json_extract(tr.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio'))), 2) AS avg_rawr
FROM trader tr
GROUP BY is_peer_mimicry_suspicion
